en.t: What is the matter, huh? ... Why will you not say anything!

units.source_text: 男人情绪又激动起来，好容易才憋住没叫出来，

en.t: The man grew agitated again, and only with great effort kept himself from shouting,

units.source_text: “真搞不懂……弄错了就弄错了，算我倒霉。

en.t: I really do not understand ... If there has been a mistake, then there has been a mistake; call it my bad luck.

units.source_text: 做也做过的事，就是啰嗦个没完，也不可能从头再来。

en.t: What has been done is done, and no amount of endless complaining can make it start over from the beginning.

units.source_text: 可最要不得的是你现在这副不说话的样子。

en.t: But the worst thing is the way you are sitting there now without saying a word.

units.source_text: 常常有这样的孩子，我老是批评他们……

en.t: There are often children like that, and I am always scolding them ...

units.source_text: 外表看上去，好像在‘自责’，

en.t: From the outside, it looks as if they are blaming themselves,

units.source_text: 其实，这是最卑怯的方法……

en.t: but in fact, that is the most cowardly way of doing things ...

units.source_text: 有辩解的话，你就赶快说出来！”

en.t: If you have an excuse, hurry up and say it!
